---
title: "Quiz banks"
subtitle: "Questions for the in-class quizzes (10% online assessment) and for self-checks"
toc: false
---

One bank per lesson. Each question names the learning outcome it checks, and
answers are folded so the page can be shown in class. Multiple-choice
questions work in Slido or any polling tool; questions marked *discussion* or
*open* are for think-pair-share and need no polling.

Each deck also ends with two to four of these questions on a *Quiz* slide.

| Lesson | Questions |
|--------|-----------|
| [00 Setup](00-setup.qmd) | 4 |
| [01 Reproducibility and open science](01-introduction.qmd) | 8 |
| [02 Project organization](02-project-organization.qmd) | 7 |
| [03 Data management and FAIR](03-data-management.qmd) | 8 |
| [04 Git and GitHub](04-git.qmd) | 7 |
| [05 Pixi and 05b Conda comparison](05-pixi.qmd) | 10 |
| [06 Jupyter](06-jupyter.qmd) | 6 |
| [07 Quarto](07-quarto.qmd) | 7 |
| [08 Containers](08-containers.qmd) | 7 |
| [09 Snakemake](09-snakemake.qmd) | 7 |
| [10 Nextflow](10-nextflow.qmd) | 6 |
| [11 Documentation](11-documentation.qmd) | 6 |
| [12 Putting it all together](12-putting-it-together.qmd) | 6 |
| [Package and share your tool](S1-packaging.qmd) | 6 |

::: {.callout-note title="For instructors"}
The banks are plain Quarto pages. To build a quiz, pick questions by outcome
and copy them into your polling tool; keep the folded answers for the debrief.
:::
